title: Deathcoords
description: Show ur death coordinates in chat!
body:
![DeathCoords](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d56363f726feb932806531212f01190c0b8ff0c2.png)

Never lose your loot again. **DeathCoords** posts a clean, styled message in chat the moment you die — with your **exact coordinates** and **dimension**, ready to copy or screenshot. **Death » 128, 64, -32 · Overworld** --- ### ✨ Why this mod? - Find your items fast after an unexpected death - No more guessing coords from the death screen - Works out of the box — no config, no keybinds, no clutter --- ## ⚡ Features - Broadcasts a **color-coded death message** to chat on every player death - Shows **block coordinates** (`x, y, z`) and a readable **dimension name** (Overworld, Nether, The End, and modded dimensions) - Lightweight server-side mod — zero gameplay changes --- ### 💬 Message format | Part | Example | |------|---------| | **Label** | `Death` (bold red) | | **Coordinates** | `128, 64, -32` (white) | | **Dimension** | `Overworld` (gold) | --- ### 🛠️ Compatibility - **Side:** Server *(clients do not need the mod to see messages)* - **Loaders:** Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge - **Game:** Java Edition **1.8.9** through **26.1.x** **Loader notes** - **NeoForge** from **1.20.2** onward - **Forge** is not available for **1.20.3**, **1.20.5**, and **1.21.2** — use Fabric or NeoForge for those versions --- ### 💙 Perfect for Survival · SMP · hardcore · cave diving · the Nether · end raids · any server where deaths happen often
